meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: 装上后,它会接手 NanoClaw v1 升到 v2 的收尾:先读迁移日志排查失败步骤,再授予 owner 角色、迁移旧记忆、核对容器配置,并协助移植自定义的 v1 代码。
howto.when: 在终端跑完 `bash migrate-v2.sh` 之后使用;当你提到 “migrate from v1”、“finish migration” 等关键词时也会触发。若迁移日志不存在,它会停下让你先跑脚本。

say.text: 看一下 handoff.json,哪些迁移步骤失败了?
say.note: 按步骤列出失败项和后续处理

say.text: 帮我这个用户授予 owner 角色
say.note: 确认用户 ID 后写入 user_roles
先暂停群组,再迁移旧记忆

howto.what_en: After install it finishes a NanoClaw v1 → v2 migration: reads the handoff log to triage failed steps, grants the owner role, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code.
howto.when_en: Use it after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes in your terminal; it also triggers on phrases like "migrate from v1" or "finish migration". If no handoff log exists, it stops and asks you to run the script first.

say_en.text: Check handoff.json — which migration steps failed?
Grant the owner role to my user
say_en.note: Writes an owner row in user_roles
